title: Add module-level explanation of single-user global Sieve architecture
description: The codebase uses a single global Sieve script (_global key) for all inbound mail. Supporting documentation exists in scattered function comments but is not collected in a central, discoverable location. When someone needs to understand the Sieve delivery path or why per-user scripts are not supported, they have to infer the design from context. Add a module-level doc comment to crates/smtp/src/session.rs or crates/smtp/src/sieve_admin.rs (or both) that explains: (1) this is a single-user system, (2) all SMTP mail is processed by one global Sieve script, (3) the global script key is '_global', (4) where the script is loaded from and how it's cached.
